purpose: Observe all five remaining gaps and every newly blind bar without modifying the recognizer.
questions: Does the timeout guard skip a same-bar candidate update or otherwise valid opposite confirmation?
Does an early opposite extremum retain an occurrence gap below four despite a long elapsed interval and internal variation?
How are missing bars split before reset, at reset and after reset/bootstrap?
Where do all 92 newly blind bars lie relative to those boundaries?
What do the five raw OHLC paths and recovered/longest-wave controls actually show?

clock_contract.same_bar_predicates: diagnostic only; never applied to the R1 state
clock_contract.event_trace: all pre/post snapshots on original bar coordinates; exact equality to frozen pivot/reset/wave ledgers required
clock_contract.gap_and_new_bar_labels: retrospective occurrence accounting, not previously available trading signals
clock_contract.EARLY_COUNTER_LOCK_label: observed invariant plus duration; not itself proof of a general causal mechanism

verification.prefixes: eight whole-history cutoffs plus immediately before and at every R1 reset

visuals.selection: all substantial residuals, twelve deterministic former gaps, both dataset edges and longest-wave control
visuals.compression: lossless gzip-base64 JSONL with each SVG byte count and SHA256; decode and verify before rendering

execution.private_readback: fixed run aggregate, image index and bounded lossless SVG view
